selected_gap.title: AI-Powered Personalized Study Companion
selected_gap.pain: Students struggle with generic study tools that don't adapt to their learning style, schedule, or emotional state, leading to low motivation and burnout. Current virtual pets lack personalization.
selected_gap.why_now: AI/ML tech is mature and affordable; students expect tailored experiences (TikTok, Spotify). Competitors like Duolingo use AI for language, but no one applies conversational AI and reinforcement learning to general study habits.
selected_gap.evidence_needed: User interviews confirming frustration with one-size-fits-all apps; prototype A/B test showing AI adaptation improves session length/frequency.

decision: The idea has merit but lacks evidence of team capability and traction. Without a strong founder with domain expertise, it's unlikely to get funded. Recommend pursuing customer discovery and building a prototype.
next_experiments: Conduct user interviews with 20 ADHD college students to validate pain and willingness to pay.
Build a minimal prototype (e.g., simple timer with pet animation) to test engagement and retention.
A/B test personalization features (e.g., adaptive break intervals) against a control to measure study session improvement.
kill_criteria: If no strong positive response from target users after 20 interviews (e.g., less than 50% express interest in paying).
If cost of AI inference per user exceeds expected LTV (e.g., $0.50/month vs. $5/month subscription).
If students are unwilling to pay for a study companion app (e.g., only free alternatives considered acceptable).
_iteration_one_liner: We help procrastinating students build consistent study habits using an AI-powered virtual pet that adapts to their focus patterns.
